title: Link Discord and WoW to Keep the Guild Chatting Wherever You Are
summary: Gather your guildmates! Link your Discord and Battle.net accounts to unlock synced guild chat across Discord and World of Warcraft.
body:
Discord’s roots in games like World of Warcraft® go pretty far back. In fact, when Discord first launched and only had a handful of users, many of them were using it for their MMO guilds! 

We figured after all these years, it’s about time we partnered with our friends at Blizzard to officially bring your Discord and World of Warcraft guild chats together.
